segments.text: An AI agent wrote a clean endpoint. But one hidden loop turned one request into one hundred and one database queries.
Here is the real test. Load one hundred orders, then fetch each customer inside the loop. The counter reaches one hundred and one.
Keep the exact data. Replace the loop with one join, so the database resolves every customer in the same query.
Run the benchmark again. One query returns the same one hundred rows, with the same total and the same first customer.
The regression test now rejects any implementation above two queries. The slow version fails. The joined version passes.
AI can draft code quickly. Production needs executable evidence: query count, result equality, and a performance budget in continuous integration.
